page.title: Houston Improv — Shows, Tickets & Info
page.meta_title: Houston Improv — Shows, Tickets & Info | Comedy Houston
page.meta_description: Upcoming shows at the Houston Improv with prices and direct ticket links, updated twice daily — plus location and venue info for Houston's biggest comedy club.
page.description_html:
The Houston Improv is the city's stop on the nationwide Improv comedy club circuit, located at 7620 Katy Fwy #431 in the Marq*E entertainment district on the Katy Freeway. It's the room where the biggest national touring headliners play when they come through Houston — the calendar below regularly features comics you know from Netflix specials, late-night TV, and the big podcasts, often for multi-night weekend runs with early and late shows.

Tickets for most shows are sold through Ticketmaster and the club's box office, and headliner weekends sell out routinely — if a Friday or Saturday name show is on your list, book early rather than at the door.

page.title: Punch Line Houston — Shows, Tickets & Info
page.meta_title: Punch Line Houston — Shows, Tickets & Info | Comedy Houston
page.meta_description: Every upcoming show at Punch Line Comedy Club Houston — headliners, showtimes, prices, and direct ticket links, updated twice daily.
page.description_html:
Punch Line Houston is a dedicated stand-up club at 2930 Sage Rd in the Galleria area, and one of the busiest rooms in the city — most weeks it runs shows Wednesday through Sunday, mixing national touring headliners with strong club regulars and Spanish-language shows (look for the "en Español" listings). It's the kind of room where you can catch a Daily Show correspondent on Friday and a rising club comic finding their hour on Sunday.

Tickets are sold through Ticketmaster; weekend headliner shows frequently sell out, and seating is typically assigned at the door by arrival time.

page.title: The Secret Group — Shows, Tickets & Info
page.meta_title: The Secret Group — Shows, Tickets & Info | Comedy Houston
page.meta_description: Upcoming comedy at The Secret Group in EaDo Houston — alternative touring comics, showcases, and open mics with prices and ticket links, updated twice daily.
page.description_html:
The Secret Group is an independent comedy venue and bar at 2101 Polk St in EaDo (East Downtown), and the center of gravity for Houston's alternative comedy scene. Across its rooms you'll find touring alt-comedy and podcast acts, local showcases, themed shows, and some of the most consistent open mics in the city — there's comedy on the calendar most nights of the week.

The venue also hosts non-comedy nights (music, karaoke, dance parties); we filter those out automatically, so the list below is only the comedy. Tickets for most shows are sold through Eventbrite, and plenty of the weekly programming is cheap or free.

page.title: The Riot Comedy Club — Shows, Tickets & Info
page.meta_title: The Riot Comedy Club — Shows, Tickets & Info | Comedy Houston
page.meta_description: Upcoming shows at The Riot Comedy Club in Montrose — weekend headliner showcases with touring comics, plus prices and ticket links, updated twice daily.
page.description_html:
The Riot Comedy Club runs in the upstairs room at Rudyard's, the long-standing Montrose pub at 2010 Waugh Dr. Its bread and butter is tightly-booked weekend headliner showcases — touring comics with credits like Kill Tony, Don't Tell Comedy, and late-night TV, backed by strong Houston openers, in a low-ceiling room that comics love because the laughs have nowhere to go.

Tickets are sold through Eventbrite and the shows are intimate by design, so popular weekends genuinely do sell out. The Riot also produces occasional shows at other Houston venues — those appear in our listings under the venue actually hosting them.

page.title: The Den Comedy Club — Shows, Tickets & Info
page.meta_title: The Den Comedy Club — Shows, Tickets & Info | Comedy Houston
page.meta_description: Upcoming shows at The Den Comedy Club in Houston — intimate speakeasy-style stand-up shows with prices and ticket links, updated twice daily.
page.description_html:
The Den Comedy Club is a speakeasy-style stand-up room in Houston — a small, intimate space where the crowd is close enough that every show feels like a private set. The lineup leans on curated showcases of Houston's working comics with touring guests mixed in, and the smaller room means shows regularly sell out on word of mouth alone.

Tickets are sold through Eventbrite; check the listings below for what's coming up.
